preregistration_note: Missing-data and wave rules are locked here BEFORE any cell can run (WP3 of omd-grok46-restart-v0.1). These rules are immutable once the first cell executes.

capacity_exclusion.rule: capacity-exhausted and usage-limit cells are excluded from quality comparison and reported separately

signal_based_detection.rule: A failed or timeout cell whose sealed receipt carries process.usage_limit_signal_detected=true with capacity evidence counts as a capacity event for wave gates and the epoch-inconclusive threshold, and is excluded from the quality comparison
signal_based_detection.rationale: A cell that wrote partial product output and then died on provider quota is conservatively terminal=failed/timeout, but the quota cause must not be misattributed as arm quality failure (Luna caf0 order4 lesson).

epoch_inconclusive.rule: A second capacity event makes the epoch inconclusive

minimum_n_per_axis.rule: arm×task axis with fewer than 2 valid trials is undecidable; undecidable never counts as a win or a loss

waves.name: Round 1
waves.description: First wave of up to 16 cells to gauge capacity and initial results
gate_conditions: Assess token usage rate vs. weekly quota

waves.name: Round 2
waves.description: Second wave of up to 16 cells
gate_conditions: If second capacity event detected, halt and mark epoch inconclusive

waves.name: Round 3
waves.description: Third wave of up to 16 cells (remaining cells)

strongest_competitor_rule.selection: For each task choose the eligible non-OmD arm by descending UI-Resolved count, then descending summed objective score with failures and omissions scored zero, then ascending variant_id.
strongest_competitor_rule.comparison: OmD must tie or beat that single selected arm in objective score in every same-task same-trial pair; a missing or non-completed result scores zero; capacity-excluded cells do not participate in this comparison.

claim_policy.public_claim_scope: Only these three preregistered tasks, exact frozen arms, exact grok-4.6/high, and this run may be described.
